product_story.problemEyebrow: Why data quality matters to the business
product_story.problemTitle: Poor ERP data rarely appears as one major incident.
product_story.problemLead: It creates recurring rework, slows processes, weakens reporting, and consumes capacity across finance, sales, purchasing, and operations.
problems: Teams repeatedly correct avoidable master-data, pricing, and document issues.
Incomplete setup and inconsistent data block posting, approvals, and downstream processes.
Incorrect or fragmented data distorts KPIs, forecasts, and management decisions.
Pricing deviations, duplicates, and bank-data issues increase financial and organizational effort.
product_story.impactNote: Illustrative example. The actual BCSentinel evaluation is based on detected findings and transparently disclosed model assumptions.
product_story.lossTitle: From a detected data issue to understandable business impact.
product_story.lossLead: BCSentinel clearly separates directly measured scan values from model assumptions. This shows which values come from Business Central and which parameters support the economic assessment.
product_story.frequency: Relevant events per record and year
product_story.disclaimer: Estimated Loss is a modeled decision-support value, not a guarantee of realized or avoidable cost.
product_story.howTitle: From technical ERP data to prioritized management decisions.
product_story.howLead: The customer journey stays lightweight while creating a defensible connection between data quality, business impact, and concrete action.
steps: The extension identifies tenant, environment, and company in a controlled way.
Module-specific checks detect data and configuration risks.
Findings are classified by severity, scale, and business relevance.
Teams receive recommendations, document exceptions, and track improvement.
product_story.lifeTitle: Assessment, Validation, and Monitoring form one connected data-health journey.
product_story.lifeLead: Assessment unlocks the complete analysis for seven days, Validation confirms remediation with a follow-up scan, and Monitoring keeps data quality under continuous control.

products.title: Assessment
products.text: Unlock the already generated Full Analysis for seven days and prioritize the most important risks.

products.title: Validation
products.text: Confirm whether corrective actions worked and which risks remain.

products.title: Monitoring
products.text: Detect new risks early and turn Data Health into an ongoing management process.

product_proof.findTitle: From a technical finding to prioritized action.
product_proof.findLead: BCSentinel connects severity, affected records, Estimated Loss, and concrete recommendations in one defensible decision view.
product_proof.detailText: Multiple vendors use identical bank details. This increases control effort and risk in the payment process.
product_proof.recommendText: Review bank details, consolidate duplicates, and mark documented exceptions where appropriate.
product_proof.reportTitle: A report management can actually use.
product_proof.reportLead: The Executive Report translates scan results into score, business impact, priorities, and next steps without overwhelming readers with technical raw data.
product_proof.dashboardTitle: One central view of health, risk, and progress.
product_proof.dashboardLead: Overview, Findings, and Monitoring work together so teams can see not only issues, but also their development and remediation status.
product_proof.sample: Representative product preview using sample data.
